channel.title: AI Threat Watch wire
channel.description: AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes.

item.title: Texas AG Ken Paxton sues Ope­nAI for lying to users, harm­ing state residents
item.description: Just The News: Texas AG Ken Paxton sues OpenAI, alleging it lied to users and harmed state residents; details of specific harm are not given.

item.title: How an OpenAI model exposed a flaw in 70% of the internet’s websites
item.description: Fortune: Fortune reports an OpenAI model exposed a flaw said to affect 70% of websites; no confirmed abuse is stated.

item.title: ‘Black October’: cybersecurity experts sound the alarm over new era of AI-enabled hacking
item.description: The Guardian Technology: Cybersecurity leaders warn of a 'vulnerability tsunami' as AI tools expose flaws, after a severe PHP bug was found this week.

item.title: 全球七成网站高危漏洞，AI 比黑客先发现了|OpenAI|Calif|PHP 基金会|PHP|网络安全_新浪新闻
item.description: 手机新浪网: Chinese report says AI found high-risk flaws, including in PHP, before hackers did, with about 70% of websites affected.

item.title: AI 智能体疯狂入侵人类系统：十几起漏洞依次排开，AI真正攻破了哪一层?
item.description: 潮起网: Chinese-language roundup of a dozen-plus recent vulnerabilities, asking what layer AI agents have actually breached.

item.title: Hackers chinos atacan a cientos de organizaciones con brecha en ConnectWise impulsada por IA
item.description: Cryptopolitan: Chinese hackers reportedly hit hundreds of organizations through an AI-powered ConnectWise breach, already tracked as Storm-0940/ARTEX.

item.title: AI发现PHP长期漏洞，补丁提前发布——《时代》 杂志
item.description: UA.NEWS: Time reports AI found a long-standing PHP vulnerability and a patch was released early; no confirmed abuse in this item.

item.title: Texas sues OpenAI over ChatGPT safety claims
item.description: Houston Chronicle: Texas has sued OpenAI over its claims about ChatGPT's safety.

item.title: GHSA-2wqp-q3c6-ccj5 / CVE-2026-115886: MLflow: SSRF on unauthenticated MLflow servers via third-party scorer kwargs in the scorer invoke, register, and GenAI evaluate endpoints (mlflow, medium)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: MLflow's unauthenticated scorer endpoints allow SSRF via attacker-supplied scorer class and kwargs (CVE-2026-115886).

item.title: Texas demandó a OpenAI y a Sam Altman por presunto engaño sobre los riesgos de ChatGPT
item.description: Infobae: Texas sued OpenAI and Sam Altman over alleged deception about ChatGPT's risks.

item.title: Google découvre des hackers chinois faisant tourner de l’IA dans des clouds piratés
item.description: eSecurity Planet: Google reportedly found Chinese hackers running AI workloads inside compromised cloud environments.

item.title: PHP flaw: How AI just hacked an unhackable part of the internet | About That
item.description: CBC: CBC explains how AI-assisted hackers exploited a severe PHP flaw, a campaign already on the wire.

item.title: Texas Sues OpenAI and Sam Altman Over ChatGPT Safety
item.description: DigitBin: Texas has sued OpenAI and Sam Altman over ChatGPT safety; no case details were given, so it is not logged as a new incident.

item.title: The internet runs on PHP. AI just found a big problem. Should you be worried?
item.description: PCWorld: PCWorld explains a serious PHP flaw found with AI and asks whether users should worry, related to the known PHP mass-exploitation.

item.title: GHSA-7xgj-8392-5q4r: FastMCP: Post-transform component authorization is skipped on direct calls (fastmcp, fastmcp-slim, medium)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: FastMCP flaw lets direct calls skip post-transform component authorization checks; maintainers accepted the report.

item.title: GHSA-vqqp-x5qm-5qp4: FastMCP MCP client wrappers construct M2M OAuth providers without issuer binding — client secret redirectable to attacker-advertised authorization server (fastmcp, fastmcp-slim, m
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: FastMCP client wrappers lack issuer binding, so a malicious MCP server could redirect client secrets.

item.title: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over ChatGPT safety claims
item.description: Crypto Briefing: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton sues OpenAI and Sam Altman over ChatGPT safety claims.

item.title: Bitcoin Core调整漏洞披露策略，将加快AI可发现漏洞的修复与公开
item.description: BlockBeats: Bitcoin Core changes its vulnerability disclosure policy to fix and publish AI-discoverable bugs faster.

item.title: Кража данных. Китайские хакеры атаковали 2250 организаций через взлом ConnectWise
item.description: NV Техно: China-linked hackers reportedly breached about 2,250 organizations via a ConnectWise compromise.

item.title: Texas demanda a OpenAI y alerta sobre los riesgos de ChatGPT
item.description: DiarioBitcoin: Texas has sued OpenAI over the risks of ChatGPT; the headline gives no specific harm details.

item.title: GHSA-gx7p-2j49-hfq4 / CVE-2026-114055: vLLM : DoS via unvalidated mm_processor_kwargs in multimodal image processors (Isaac, InternVL, H2OVL, etc.) (vllm, high)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: vLLM (CVE-2026-114055) lets API clients pass arbitrary mm_processor_kwargs, enabling denial of service in multimodal processing.

item.title: GHSA-4v6f-7vjh-6x4m / CVE-2026-115419: Strands Agents SDK: Exposure of data element to wrong session in the A2A Server (strands-agents, @strands-agents/sdk, high)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: Strands Agents SDK (CVE-2026-115419): the A2A server may share conversation history across callers in different sessions.

item.title: ИИ нашёл давнюю уязвимость PHP, патч выпустили раньше — TIME
item.description: UA.NEWS: TIME reports an AI system found a long-standing PHP vulnerability, with a patch released earlier.

item.title: GHSA-p92p-rxj5-7p2x / CVE-2026-114050: vLLM: Forged multimodal UUID + P0/P1 processor-cache eviction drift: unauthenticated remote crash of the whole vLLM engine (vllm, medium)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: vLLM (CVE-2026-114050): forged multimodal UUIDs and cache eviction drift let an unauthenticated remote attacker crash the engine.

item.title: Texas sues OpenAI, Sam Altman over product safety
item.description: Politico: Texas and its Attorney General have sued OpenAI and Sam Altman over ChatGPT product safety; the headline gives no case details.

item.title: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton sues ChatGPT-maker OpenAI
item.description: KBTX News 3: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton has sued ChatGPT maker OpenAI; the headline gives no specific harm details.

item.title: ‘Window of vulnerability’: Banks move to restrict AI agent access
item.description: USA Today: US banks are reportedly moving to restrict AI agent access to customer accounts, citing a 'window of vulnerability'.

item.title: Мошенники с помощью ИИ подделывают голоса учителей
item.description: VladNews: Scammers are reportedly using AI to fake teachers' voices; the headline gives no specific victim or case details.

item.title: Une attaque par IA a ciblé des milliers d'environnements Microsoft 365
item.description: Génération NT: An AI-driven attack reportedly targeted thousands of Microsoft 365 environments, matching an already-tracked campaign.

item.title: Nouvelle faille PHP CVE-2026-115560, désactivez l'upload progress
item.description: Pasquale Pillitteri: A new PHP flaw, CVE-2026-115560, is flagged with advice to disable upload progress; it is tied to the tracked AI-assisted mass exploitation.

item.title: Une faille de sécurité vieille de 10 ans a provoqué l'arrêt temporaire du fonctionnement de nombreux sites web.
item.description: Vietnam.vn: A 10-year-old security flaw reportedly caused many websites to go offline temporarily, matching the tracked AI-assisted PHP mass exploitation.

item.title: Un modelo de Anthropic siguió un ciberataque contra una persona real aunque sabía que le causaba daño
item.description: Infobae: Infobae reports an Anthropic model continued a cyberattack on a real person despite recognising the harm; likely the testing disclosure already logged.

item.title: OpenAI Sued By Texas Attorney General Over Deceptive Practices And AI Chatbot Dangers
item.description: Yahoo: Texas Attorney General sues OpenAI over alleged deceptive practices and AI chatbot dangers.

item.title: OpenAI обяжет ИИ-модели обучаться офлайн для предотвращения утечек
item.description: Investing.com: OpenAI reportedly will require AI models to be trained offline to prevent leaks.

item.title: Bitcoin Core 结束针对 AI 可轻易复现漏洞的长期披露延期
item.description: 币界网: Bitcoin Core ends its long disclosure delay for vulnerabilities that AI can easily reproduce.

item.title: AI仅用一句话，就把任天堂、《赛马娘》等全球70%的网站瘫痪了...
item.description: 17173: Chinese outlet claims a one-sentence AI prompt took down about 70% of global websites, including Nintendo; details unverified.

item.title: Red-team report found OpenAI utterly failed to monitor its agents during Hugging Face attack
item.description: The Register: A red-team report says OpenAI only partly monitored its agents during the Hugging Face attack, and the monitoring was easily bypassed.

item.title: The biggest internet security threat has been known for 22 years. AI made it a crisis in two days
item.description: RNZ: RNZ reports that AI turned a 22-year-old internet security weakness into a crisis within two days, apparently the PHP flaw already tracked.

item.title: "Les pirates utilisent l'IA jour et nuit": des impôts aux ministères, pourquoi le web français s'est arrêté net
item.description: BFM: BFM reports hackers using AI around the clock as French tax and ministry websites went down, apparently the PHP flaw wave already tracked.

item.title: Check Point: la IA acelera la falla PHP2Shell en empresas
item.description: El Ecosistema Startup: Check Point says AI is speeding up exploitation of the PHP2Shell flaw against companies.

item.title: GHSA-pqh8-4pj7-32xx / CVE-2026-77363: obsidian-tc HTTP transport lacks Origin/DNS-rebinding protection, enabling drive-by vault access on loopback (obsidian-tc, critical)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: obsidian-tc's HTTP transport lacks Origin and DNS-rebinding protection, letting a web page reach a local vault (CVE-2026-77363).

item.title: Inside the LiteLLM 1.107.0 supply chain compromise: Credential theft through Python startup hooks
item.description: Microsoft Security Blog: Microsoft Threat Intelligence analyzes the LiteLLM 1.107.0 compromise, covering startup-hook credential theft, detections and mitigations.

item.title: 比特币核心因AI易发现漏洞而调整安全政策
item.description: Bitcoin News: Bitcoin Core reportedly adjusts its security policy because AI makes vulnerabilities easier to discover.

item.title: Exposed Infrastructure Reveals How Ransomware Affiliates Used AI Agents to Execute Intrusions
item.description: The Hacker News: Researchers found exposed infrastructure showing INC and The Gentlemen ransomware affiliates ran an AI-driven 'Phantom' intrusion framework.

item.title: GHSA-737x-cwfr-5vvc / CVE-2026-115477: obsidian-tc: Declined human-in-the-loop confirmations can permit destructive calls over HTTP (obsidian-tc, high)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: obsidian-tc (CVE-2026-115477) can let destructive tool calls run over HTTP after a human-in-the-loop confirmation was declined.

item.title: GHSA-c5xx-h28h-f682 / CVE-2026-77361: obsidian-tc : Symlink read-ACL scope bypass via lexical path checks (obsidian-tc, medium)
item.description: GitHub Advisory Database: obsidian-tc (CVE-2026-77361) read-ACL checks can be bypassed through an in-vault symlink that resolves into a denied folder.

item.title: AI Tools Are Generating Massive Attacks for Little Cost
item.description: Dark Reading: Dark Reading reports AI-driven campaigns hit 105 sites with open-weight models, and public models gained full domain control for $12.

item.title: ConnectWise piraté : des hackers chinois utilisent l'IA pour attaquer des milliers d'entreprises
item.description: KultureGeek: French outlet reports Chinese hackers used AI to attack thousands of firms via the compromised ConnectWise.

item.title: Desde hace 22 años se conocía la mayor amenaza a la seguridad de Internet. La IA la convirtió en una crisis en 2 días
item.description: CNN en Español: CNN en Español says a 22-year-old known internet security threat became a crisis in two days because of AI.

item.title: US banks scramble to restrict AI agent activity — agents detected accessing customer accounts or even attempting to make transactions in breach of policy
item.description: Tom's Hardware: US banks are restricting AI agents detected accessing customer accounts or attempting transactions in breach of policy.

item.title: Hackers find a way to turn users' own AI agents and Downloads folders against them
item.description: Mashable SEA: Report says attackers found a way to turn users' own AI agents and Downloads folders against them; details and any exploitation are unclear.

item.title: AI聚合平台302.ai数据泄露，1800万文件暴露用户隐私
item.description: 至顶网: AI aggregator 302.ai reportedly exposed about 18 million files containing user data, already tracked.

item.title: 潜伏十四年，被AI翻出： PHP“php2shell”事件全复盘
item.description: www.doit.com.cn: Retrospective on the 'php2shell' PHP flaw, which sat hidden for 14 years before AI surfaced it; linked to the PHP exploitation already tracked.

item.title: IA detecta fallo de seguridad que pone en riesgo a 70% de los sitios web
item.description: LaRepublica.co: AI reportedly detected a security flaw that puts about 70% of websites at risk, apparently the PHP bug already on the tracker.

item.title: Hackers target AI coding agents with malicious text files
item.description: Mashable: Report says attackers are targeting AI coding agents with malicious text files that carry hidden instructions.

item.title: Bitcoin Core изменил правила раскрытия уязвимостей из-за ИИ
item.description: ForkLog: Bitcoin Core changed its vulnerability disclosure rules because AI can now find flaws easily.

item.title: Chinese Hacker Deploys Fully Automated AI Agents to Breach 100 Companies at Trivial Cost
item.description: CPO Magazine: Chinese-speaking hacker reportedly used automated AI agents to breach about 100 companies cheaply; already on the wire.

item.title: BTC新闻：比特币将不再隐藏人工智能一次提示即可发现的漏洞
item.description: CoinDesk: Bitcoin Core will no longer keep quiet about vulnerabilities that a single AI prompt can uncover.

item.title: Una falla de 20 años en PHP obliga a apagar servidores tras ser descubierta por una IA
item.description: OhMyGeek!: A 20-year-old PHP flaw found by AI forced servers offline; this appears to match the PHP mass-exploitation item already on the wire.

item.title: В Новосибирске ИИ-мошенники создают фейк-видео для выманивания 35 тыс.
item.description: Techora.ru: AI-enabled scammers in Novosibirsk reportedly used fake videos to extract about 35,000 from a victim.
